instruction:
Pogo-pin bed adapter with board-derived pin field. The desktop contains `/home/user/Desktop/board_input.kicad_pcb`, `/home/user/Desktop/mechanical_requirements.json`, `/home/user/Desktop/connector_keepouts.csv`, `/home/user/Desktop/enclosure_seed.scad`, and `/home/user/Desktop/handoff_notes.md`. The handoff notes are supplementary and cannot override the KiCad board, requirements JSON, or connector CSV. KiCad-derived JSON, CSV, and SCAD handoffs may be generated by a deterministic parser within the KiCad stage; real KiCad processing and the parser handoffs must both complete before OpenSCAD consumes them, but no particular helper script name or ordering between those KiCad-stage operations is required. Run the CLI handoff in this order: KiCad -> OpenSCAD -> FreeCAD -> Blender. Use the KiCad board for the PCB outline, thickness, footprint centers, mounting axes, component heights, and keepout radii; use the requirements for installed placement, tray/lid/standoff geometry, clearances, tolerances, and material; use the connector CSV for access type, direction, finished dimensions, cutter bounds, and continuous-path bounds.

Use the PCB outline center as package XY origin and the tray bottom outer face as Z=0 without rotating or mirroring KiCad X/Y. Build the specified 107.6 x 83.6 x 20.4 mm covering PC package as a tray ending at Z=17.5 plus a separate 2.8 mm lid beginning at Z=17.6, preserving the 0.1 mm assembly separation. The inner cavity must be X=-51..51 and Y=-39..39. Seat the 1.6 mm PCB bottom at Z=6.6 on four 3.8 mm high bored standoffs aligned to MH1-MH4, using 6.9 mm outer diameter and 3.2 mm bore diameter, and preserve 4 mm clearance to every inner side wall. The tallest J1 body ends at Z=12.6, leaving 5.0 mm to the lid inner face.

Every TP1-TP4 pogo target must map one-to-one to a 5.0 mm finished-diameter Z_PLUS lid bore on the KiCad target axis. Each lid cutter runs from Z=17.1 to 20.9, and the full access column from target top Z=8.4 to exterior Z=20.9 must contain no residual enclosure material. J1 must remain externally accessible through the bounded 22 x 6 mm Y_PLUS side window with cutter bounds `[-11.0, 38.5, 7.4, 11.0, 42.3, 13.4]` in `[xmin, ymin, zmin, xmax, ymax, zmax]` order; it must not become a full-height slot. Apply the specified access overcut, center/axis tolerances, and minimum guard. Extra structural features are allowed only when all accesses, guards, board clearances, and interference requirements remain valid.

Calculate PC enclosure volume/mass, all four PCB side clearances, each component clearance to the nearest covering enclosure material over its XY footprint, four standoff bore checks, one-to-one TP access alignment and continuity, J1 window direction and continuity, and unintended interference from submitted geometry. In Blender, preserve real tray, lid, PCB, component, and access-review objects; visibly distinguish TP1-TP4 and J1; save a native scene and render a nonblank review image.

Produce every required artifact directly on the desktop:
- `01_kicad_board.kicad_pcb`
- `01_kicad_export.json`
- `01_kicad_board.step`
- `01_kicad_mechanical_map.csv`
- `01_kicad_parameters.scad`
- `02_openscad_enclosure.scad`
- `02_openscad_enclosure.stl`
- `02_openscad_parameters.json`
- `03_freecad_assembly.step`
- `03_freecad_assembly.obj`
- `03_freecad_clearance_report.json`
- `04_blender_review.blend`
- `04_blender_review.obj`
- `04_blender_review.mtl`
- `04_blender_review.png`
- `04_blender_scene_report.json`
- `toolchain_invocation_log.json`
- `final_release_package.json`

The files must follow this sequence: KiCad must load the board, derive the CSV/JSON/SCAD handoffs, and export `01_kicad_board.step`; OpenSCAD must include the KiCad-derived parameter handoff and render the submitted STL; FreeCAD must consume `01_kicad_board.step`, the KiCad export data, OpenSCAD STL, and parameters, then export a real solid STEP assembly and OBJ; Blender must consume the FreeCAD OBJ/report and save, export, and render the review. The FreeCAD report must include geometry-derived `enclosure_volume_mm3`, `enclosure_mass_g`, `side_clearances_mm`, `minimum_side_clearance_mm`, `component_top_clearances_mm`, `minimum_top_clearance_mm`, `standoff_checks`, `access_checks`, `unintended_interference_volume_mm3`, and `decision`. Extra fields and artifacts are allowed. Tool retries and auxiliary calls are allowed, but the productive KiCad -> OpenSCAD -> FreeCAD -> Blender sequence, versions, inputs, and outputs must be recorded. The final package must include every required artifact and may only report pass when geometry-derived checks pass. [Software] Use `kicad-cli` or KiCad scripting, `openscad`, `FreeCADCmd`/`freecadcmd`, and `blender --background --python` in that order. Use `/usr/bin/kicad-cli`, `/usr/bin/openscad`, `/home/user/.local/bin/freecadcmd`, and `/snap/bin/blender` for the four stages, in that order.
